channel.title: HK IPO HOT
channel.description: Hong Kong IPO subscription calendar: now subscribing, listing soon, listing today, grey market and debut — titles, one-line summaries and links only.

item.title: Beijing Sinotau International Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (09941)
item.description: Biotech firm Sinotau is now taking subscriptions at HK$52.00-68.00, closing 19 November and listing 24 November, with grey-market trading on 23 November; it focuses on radiopharmaceutical diagnostics and therapies.

item.title: Ganzhou Hemay Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (00054)
item.description: Biotech firm Hemay has published an offer range of HK$15.50-18.90, but its listing date has been delayed and the outcome is still pending.

item.title: Changzhou Microintelligence Co., Ltd. (03275)
item.description: Robotics company Microintelligence has published an offer range of HK$16.63-21.46, with the listing date still to be set.

item.title: Jiangsu Slender West Lake Culture and Tourism Co., Ltd. (06157)
item.description: Tourism company Slender West Lake has published an offer range of HK$3.92-5.07, with the listing date still to be set.

item.title: Yongkang Holdings Limited (02523)
item.description: Logistics firm Yongkang Holdings has published an offer price of HK$2.44, with the listing date still to be set.
